title: 3.7L Duratec Ignition: System and Component References
introduction:
This reference applies to Engine Ignition - 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS). I read the system explanation as the plot and the component descriptions as the cast list: understanding how things work together gives the individual parts some meaning.

Both explanations require the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, at the location given below. This page directs that reading; it contains no ignition operating details, component descriptions, diagnostic tests or repair steps.

edits.text: For the ignition system’s operating explanation, read the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. See Section 1 Description and Operation.
edits.why: The whole-system explanation gives you context for understanding the individual components.

edits.text: For descriptions of the ignition components, read the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. See Section 1 Description and Operation.
edits.why: Use the component descriptions to connect each part’s role with the overall operating explanation.
